summary: Sublette County, WY site on the Bridger NF; FFLA lists it as undocumented and West Lookouts marks it Removed. No build date, staffing or remains found.

facts.status_note: West Lookouts marks the site Removed; no source gives a removal date or describes what remains

events.note: Pinedale Roundup story dated September 29, 1960 refers to the top of Willow Creek lookout
1968 map of the Fremont Lake North area, per Pastmaps' description, shows a Willow Creek Lookout

evidence.supports: Site is in Sublette County, Bridger National Forest
FFLA lists the site at 43.09987, -109.86983 in Sublette County
FFLA files the site under unknown and undocumented sites
Site would move to the lookout lists only if evidence shows regular fire-lookout use
evidence.quote: If evidence or documentation is uncovered showing that any of these were actually used as regular wildland fire lookout sites, they will be moved to the lookout lists.

evidence.supports: Pinedale Roundup story is dated September 29, 1960
Story is reprinted from the Pinedale Roundup
Story follows a 60-year-old man separated from fishing companions
evidence.quote: The 60-year-old man became separated from a party of fishing companions

evidence.supports: The man spent Sunday night below the top of the lookout
evidence.quote: Crews said he spent Sunday night below the top of the Lookout.

evidence.supports: Former forest ranger Harmon Shannon, as the article reports, said he hiked up to Willow Creek lookout
evidence.quote: former forest ranger Harmon Shannon said he hiked to within a quarter of a mile of Trapper lake, around Section Corner lakes and to the top of Willow Creek lookout

evidence.supports: Pastmaps' map description names a Willow Creek Lookout
West Lookouts marks the site as Removed
A separate Willow Creek Guard Station is on the Pinedale Ranger District
evidence.quote: Willow Creek Guard Station on the Pinedale Ranger District

evidence.supports: That guard station was constructed by the CCC in the early 1930s
evidence.quote: since constructed by the CCC in the early 1930s

corrections.why: West Lookouts marks the site Removed

sources.title: 1968 Map of Fremont Lake North, Sublette County, WY

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a 1960 newspaper story reprinted on West Lookouts, a Willow Creek Lookout label on a 1968 map as described by Pastmaps (secondary), and FFLA's undocumented listing. No build date, design, staffing or fate date found. Possible leads: Pinedale Roundup archive for the 1960 story and any removal notice; Bridger-Teton district records for the lookout's history. The guard station of the same name is a different structure and should not be merged into this record.
